row.notes: Loop over the 4 wheels ([car+0x580]+0x70+i*8) writing a 3x4 wheel transform to rig+0xb50+i*0x30 and the wheel-node pose matrices of the skeleton [rig+0x38] (node ids per wheel at rig+0x5f4/+0x660/+0x6a8/+0x6cc, stride 0xfc; each write sets the node's dirty bit with a locked or and clears byte +0x40 bit 1). A wheel with a model-node override ([wheel]+0x5d0 -> +0xe8[idx], byte +0x38 set) takes that node's local matrix (vcall +0x38) times the body matrix [car+0x558]+0x1d0..+0x20f and Car_Compute_ChassisMatrix([car+0x558]). Otherwise it builds the hub from wheel spin/steer and suspension (wheel +0x154/+0x174/+0x178, [wheel+0x140]+0x1600/+0x1604, side sign table 0x1455d8b30 by wheel +0x2b4 == 2), Car_Compute_ChassisMatrix([rig+0x58]+0x558) and, when [car]+0x9f40 > 6, Car_Suspension_ComputeWheelTransform (0x1446b8ce0); rig+0xfc8+i == 0 clears one matrix. Calls from Car_Parse_Chassis (0x14462ea68) and the rig transform update 0x144631e50 (0x144632071). Used by vmknolle dukati-lean (wheels on the centre line).
